fix: VM: ship the guest kernel's modules (linux-modules-extra) in the VM image so sudo modprobe loop works (issue #43).
Allow network namespaces: security.nesting=true in the profile and no AppArmor/seccomp deny on unshare/setns (issue #43).
Allow adding a dummy link and an address: CAP_NET_ADMIN in the sandbox's user namespace (security.nesting=true) and the dummy module on the host (issue #43).
Allow ioctl on /dev/random: check the sandbox's seccomp and AppArmor policy (issue #43).
Allow tmpfs mounts under sudo: security.nesting=true and the profile's raw.lxc that keeps /proc, /sys and the cgroup tree writable (issue #7).
Allow unprivileged user namespaces and overlay mounts for mkosi: kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0 and overlay support in the kernel (issue #7).
VM: the image needs the dm_crypt and nbd modules (linux-modules-extra) and cryptsetup (issue #44).
VM: DNS inside a podman container must work; check AppArmor for podman/buildah and that the egress filter allows DNS (issue #63).
More CPUs are online than the job can use, so tools oversubscribe: give the sandbox a cpuset (limits.cpu as a count or a range, not a time quota) so it sees only its own CPUs (issue #38).
VM: expose /dev/kvm (nested virtualization) inside the VM (issues #33, #110).
VM: delete_module must reach the kernel (ENOENT), not be filtered by seccomp (ENOSYS) (issue #3).
Image pulls stall in the TLS handshake: the bridge MTU (bridge.mtu on lxdbr0/incusbr0) and docker's MTU must not exceed the PowerVS network MTU (pi_network_mtu) (issue #59).
mmdebstrap's own network namespace cannot resolve names: check the sandbox's resolver setup and that the egress filter allows DNS (issue #43).
VM: install perf and allow unprivileged cycles:u (kernel.perf_event_paranoid <= 2) (issue #71).
A privileged docker run (mock) must work: nesting on and AppArmor not blocking docker's privileged operations (issue #78).
The Kata pause image build (sudo make) failed: read the log tail; usually the git clone, a registry pull or docker inside the sandbox (issue #43).
kind needs privileged docker in the VM: check docker in the VM image and the 'Setup kind' step of this job (issue #49).
The sandbox's ID map is smaller than the runner's /etc/subuid range: on Incus hosts run --tags incus_idmap (1e9 IDs); on LXD give root a large enough subordinate range (issue #143).

A port builds use, open on GitHub-hosted, is blocked here: the egress allowlist must open git 9418, HKP 11371, rsync 873, 8080/8443/5000, SMTP 587/465 and databases 5432/3306/6379/27017. Add the missing port to container-egress-filter.policy.xml (PowerVS, then --tags egress_filter) or to GHA_EGRESS in vpc-on-ibm-z tasks/container_egress_filter.yml (IBM Z, reprovision).
